description: Keep evidence that a public page said something, dated and independent of you: the fetched text, its sha256, final URL and status, signed by a third party and written to a public append-only log anchored daily on Bitcoin and Software Heritage. Useful for disputes, deleted pages and changed terms. Free signed sample: /x402/proof-of-publication/sample. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call without payment to get the requirements (isError result, 402 object in structuredContent); retry with the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']. Result is signed by neo and logged.
name: paid_proof_of_publication
title: Paid: proof of publication (0.50 USDC)
